name: lacuno
description: Design, build and publish websites in Lacuno: connects Lacuno Cloud and adds skills for building pages, checking your work, content and forms

interface.longDescription:
Lacuno is a website builder. This plugin lets ChatGPT design, build, edit and publish websites in your Lacuno account.

What it does
- Builds pages and whole sites from a brief, a mockup or a screenshot: layout, text, images and styles.
- Edits existing pages: text, sections, navigation, colours, fonts and spacing. Every change arrives live on the Lacuno editor canvas, so you watch the site take shape and can take over by hand at any point.
- Checks its own work with text previews and screenshots at any width, including phone width.
- Manages content: collections and entries such as blog posts, team members or projects, and shows them on pages.
- Adds contact, signup and feedback forms that email submissions to the site owner.
- Publishes the site when you ask. Published sites are fast static HTML on Lacuno Cloud, hosted in Germany.

Who it is for
People and small teams who want a website without writing code: freelancers, studios, clubs, local businesses, and anyone who would rather describe a site and see it built. Designers who want a quick first draft to refine by hand in the Lacuno editor.

What it needs and what it does not do
- A Lacuno account. You sign in when connecting, and the plugin works only on the sites you own or edit.
- Publishing is available to a site owner. Editors can change a site but not publish it.
- It does not register domains and does not host anything outside Lacuno.
- Disconnect at any time under Settings, Connected AI apps, in Lacuno.
